name: Santa Cam
tagline: AI Santa videos from a photo of your home
description: Santa Cam is a browser-based AI Christmas video maker for parents. Choose a style, add a photo of your front door, living room, tree or house, and type up to three first names. Styles include Santa at the door, Santa leaving presents under the tree, a sleigh flying over the house, a Nice List check, a recorded pretend video call, Santa meeting your pet and eleven toy-elf actions. You can add one short line for Santa to say. Videos are 10 to 15 seconds, HD, with no watermark, and usually ready in 5 to 10 minutes. Example videos can be watched free without an account.
